notes: 网课教程：知识精讲/跟练/系统课/项目交付；各语言平台热门课型叶子。

craft.sentence: 定义→例子→误区→带走一句
craft.stance: 知识服务感，不装学院腔
craft.opening: 听众以为自己懂的一点
craft.avoid: 鸡汤空转、无例题、写死某一学科清单
craft.lexicon: 简单说、记住、别误会、这一课

referenceParagraph.zh: 别先背定义。先戳破一个常见误解，再用生活例子拆开，最后留一句学员能转述的话。
referenceParagraph.zh-TW: 别先背定义。先戳破一个常见误解，再用生活例子拆开，最后留一句学员能转述的话。
referenceParagraph.en: Don’t start with the textbook. Bust a common misunderstanding, unpack with a lived example, leave one line they can retell.
referenceParagraph.ja: Don’t start with the textbook. Bust a common misunderstanding, unpack with a lived example, leave one line they can retell.

craft.sentence: 步骤编号；口播同步动作
craft.opening: 成品预览 + 今天只做哪一步
craft.avoid: 炫技跳步、羞辱新手、写死编程/摄影等固定学科
craft.lexicon: 暂停、跟上、常见卡点、先别管

referenceParagraph.zh: 先看成品十秒。今天只做到「能验收的一小步」。卡住别慌——给出三步绕行再继续。
referenceParagraph.zh-TW: 先看成品十秒。今天只做到「能验收的一小步」。卡住别慌——给出三步绕行再继续。
referenceParagraph.en: Ten seconds of the finished thing. Today only one checkable step. Stuck? Offer a three-step detour, then continue.
referenceParagraph.ja: Ten seconds of the finished thing. Today only one checkable step. Stuck? Offer a three-step detour, then continue.

craft.sentence: 地图→本章位置→核心论证→预告下一章
craft.opening: 把学习者放回课程地图
craft.avoid: 碎片爽点、无衔接、写死学科清单
craft.lexicon: 上一章、本节、因此、下一章你会

referenceParagraph.zh: 先看地图：你卡在哪一环。本节只解决这一环，案例与练习留给下一章。
referenceParagraph.zh-TW: 先看地图：你卡在哪一环。本节只解决这一环，案例与练习留给下一章。
referenceParagraph.en: Map first: which link are you stuck on? This section clears only that link; drills wait for next chapter.
referenceParagraph.ja: Map first: which link are you stuck on? This section clears only that link; drills wait for next chapter.

craft.sentence: 完成定义→里程碑→示范→验收
craft.avoid: 只讲理念不交件、写死必须是代码仓库
craft.lexicon: 完成物、里程碑、验收、今天必须

referenceParagraph.zh: 完成物先说清楚。今天三十分钟只做一个可验收的里程碑，其余降级。
referenceParagraph.zh-TW: 完成物先说清楚。今天三十分钟只做一个可验收的里程碑，其余降级。
referenceParagraph.en: Define done first. Today’s thirty minutes: one checkable milestone; everything else can degrade.
referenceParagraph.ja: Define done first. Today’s thirty minutes: one checkable milestone; everything else can degrade.

craft.sentence: 目標→步驟→示範→練習；短段
craft.lexicon: 這一課、先做、常見錯、交作業

referenceParagraph.zh: 這一課結束你要交出一頁大綱，不是「聽懂了」。我們拆成四步，每步不超過八分鐘。
referenceParagraph.zh-TW: 這一課結束你要交出一頁大綱。
referenceParagraph.en: By the end you hand in a one-page outline—not “I get it.” Four steps, each under eight minutes.
referenceParagraph.ja: 終わりに一枚のアウトラインを出す。「わかった」ではない。

craft.lexicon: watch this, try this, the rule is

referenceParagraph.zh: 先看一段失败开场，再抽出那条可复用的规则，最后你改自己的第一段。
referenceParagraph.zh-TW: 先看失敗開場，再抽規則，最後改你的第一段。
referenceParagraph.en: First a failed opening, then the reusable rule, then you rewrite your own first paragraph.
referenceParagraph.ja: 失敗の冒頭→再利用できる法則→自分の一段を直す。

craft.opening: What you can do after this module
craft.lexicon: by the end, key term, self-check

referenceParagraph.zh: 本模块结束你能：用自己的话解释 X，并完成一道自测。
referenceParagraph.zh-TW: 本模組結束你能解釋 X 並完成自測。
referenceParagraph.en: By module end you can explain X in your own words and pass a short self-check.
referenceParagraph.ja: 終了時、X を自分の言葉で説明し、小テストを通す。

craft.opening: What we’re solving in one line
craft.lexicon: next, pause, try it, common mistake

referenceParagraph.zh: 别一次跳三步。我们只做下一步：把式子移项，然后你暂停自己算。
referenceParagraph.zh-TW: 別一次跳三步。只做移項，然後暫停自算。
referenceParagraph.en: Don’t leap three steps. Only the next move: rearrange, then pause and compute yourself.
referenceParagraph.ja: 三段飛ばし禁止。次の一手だけ：移項して、自分で止めて計算。

craft.opening: 明日の会議で使えるか
craft.lexicon: 型、明日、よくある失敗、宿題

referenceParagraph.zh: 明天会上直接可用的一句模板，比再讲一遍理论重要。
referenceParagraph.zh-TW: 明天會議能用的一句模板，勝過再講理論。
referenceParagraph.en: A sentence you can use in tomorrow’s meeting beats another theory slide.
referenceParagraph.ja: 明日の会議で使える一句が、理論スライドより大事。

craft.lexicon: 得点、ひっかけ、類題、ここだけ

referenceParagraph.zh: 这题只考一个点：读题干里的限定词。我们先拆真题，再做一道变式。
referenceParagraph.zh-TW: 這題只考限定詞。先拆真題再做變式。
referenceParagraph.en: This item tests one thing: the limiter in the stem. Real item first, then a twin.
referenceParagraph.ja: 問うのは一点：題幹の限定。本問→類題。

craft.lexicon: 完成物、マイルストーン、今やる

referenceParagraph.zh: 先定义完成文件长什么样，再倒推今天三十分钟必须做完的第一步。
referenceParagraph.zh-TW: 先定義完成檔，再倒推今天三十分鐘的第一步。
referenceParagraph.en: Define the finished file, then reverse-plan the first thirty minutes you must finish today.
referenceParagraph.ja: 完成物の姿を先に決め、今日30分で終わる一手へ逆算。
